label: common_2020_esper_010_esper_02
text: Your beauty has become even more refined since\nthe last time we met.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

label: common_2020_esper_010_esper_03a
text: Oh! Accepting compliments with grace, I see.\nHow wonderful. I hope you remain that way.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

label: common_2020_esper_010_esper_03b
text: Who taught you the art of flattery? Is my young\nfriend all grown up now?[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

label: common_2020_esper_010_esper_04
text: So you’re here in place of Geeta, are you?[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

label: common_2020_esper_010_esper_05
text: Just between you and me, I’m not exactly her\nbiggest fan. That bewitching aura of hers\r\noverlaps too much with my own style.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

label: common_2020_esper_010_esper_06
text: So it may be for the best that she sent someone\nelse for the job.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

label: common_2020_esper_010_esper_07
text: With you, I feel like I can really give this battle\nall I’ve got.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

label: common_2020_esper_010_esper_08
text: Without further ado, are you ready to pursue\nquintessential beauty together?[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

label: common_2020_esper_010_esper_09
text: Oh, wonderful. Let’s head to the battle court.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

label: common_2020_esper_010_esper_10
text: I’m very busy, you know. Come right back\nchop-chop, would you?[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
